records.title: chore(editors): bump brace-expansion security releases
records.release_claim: the packaged extension dependency graph excludes the known brace-expansion denial-of-service versions
records.reason: The lockfile-only update resolves two high-severity advisories and leaves npm audit at zero; omitting it contradicts the selected VSIX security posture.
records.non_claim: The dependency update does not change RIPR analysis or protocol semantics.

records.title: fix(xtask): reject duplicate keys in the evidence-promotion corpus
records.release_claim: the honesty corpus cannot silently drop an earlier semantic pin through JSON last-key-wins parsing
records.reason: A spliced duplicate key removed a negative case while every gate stayed green. All honesty-corpus loaders now fail closed and a negative fixture pins the exact corruption shape.
records.non_claim: Duplicate-key rejection does not make the corpus a universal accuracy benchmark.

records.title: docs(LEARNINGS): record merge cleanup, red-arm restore, and blocked-lag discipline
records.reason: Useful operating history with no runtime, package, schema, or source-promotion dependency.
records.non_claim: Deferral does not remove the CI or merge protections implemented elsewhere.

records.title: refactor(cli): extract the doctor command family
records.reason: The doctor entrypoint, exclusive helpers, and tests move with byte/output parity; required process-policy paths are repointed without changing probe behavior.
records.non_claim: The extraction does not change doctor support or runtime detection semantics.

records.title: refactor(xtask): extract the evidence-promotion-honesty cluster
records.reason: Ninety-five functions and their report machinery move with byte-identical output, fixture parity, and zero golden drift; the semantic duplicate-key fix remains independently classified.
records.non_claim: Extraction does not change promotion rules or corpus expectations.

records.title: refactor(xtask): extract the fixture-contracts cluster
records.reason: The large validator region is split into focused modules because one moved file would itself exceed the health threshold; dispatch and semantic validation remain unchanged.
records.non_claim: This does not alter fixture contracts or close every xtask decomposition item.

records.title: refactor(xtask): extract the editor fixture validators
records.reason: The five editor fixture validators move with test-list, suite, and output parity; static-language allowances follow the moved negative-claim literals.
records.non_claim: Moving validators does not strengthen editor support evidence.

records.title: refactor(xtask): extract gap and report fixture validators
records.reason: The remaining gap/report validators and shared helpers move so no validate-fixture-corpus function remains in main.rs; current decisions and outputs are preserved.
records.non_claim: This does not change gap, report, or packet semantics.

records.title: refactor(xtask): extract the goldens and fixture-runner cluster
records.reason: The check/bless, fixture-runner, report, and drift-semantics region moves with byte-identical behavior and zero golden drift.
